create_instance: create a private computation instance with a given role, game type, input path, and container counts
run_next: run the next stage of a private computation instance by its instance ID
validate: validate the metrics of a private computation instance against an expected result path
get_instance: get the updated status of a private computation instance by its instance ID
build_private_computation_service: build a PrivateComputationService from config dicts for private computation, MPC, PID, and post-processing handlers
